labelsets.name: author_cell_type
labelsets.description: Annotation of cell types in dataset based on prior knowledge

labels.name: immature LAMs
labels.rationale: Marker genes are top 10 DEGs for this population compared with others in the UMAP (from Table S2 in publication).

labels.name: Mono
labels.rationale: The marker genes are the top 10 DEGs for this cell population compared with the others (from Table S2 in publication). Canonical marker genes are used throughout literature.

labels.name: cDC1s
labels.rationale: Marker genes are top 10 DEGs for this population compared with others in UMAP (from Table S2 in publication). Canonical marker genes routinely used to identify cDC1s across species.

labels.name: cDC2s
labels.rationale: The marker genes are the top 10 DEGs for this population compared with the rest in the UMAP (From Table S2 in publication).

labels.name: Mac1
labels.rationale: Marker genes are top 10 DEGs for this population compared with other cell types in the UMAP (from Table S2 in publication). This population has not been described before and shares genes with macrophages and DC3s thus the true definition of this cell remains a question.

labels.name: Pat Mono
labels.rationale: The marker genes are the top 10 DEGs for this population compared with others in the UMAP (from Table S2 in publication). SPN and FCGR3A are canonical genes used in both human and mouse.

labels.name: Pre-moKCs and moKCs
labels.rationale: Marker genes are top 10 DEGs for this population compared with other cell types in the UMAP (from Table S2 in publication).

labels.name: mature LAMs
labels.rationale: Marker genes are top 10 DEGs for this population compared with all others in the UMAP (from Table S2 in publication). Canonical markers are the conserved human-mouse LAM signature genes we defined in the publication.

labels.name: ResKCs
labels.rationale: The marker genes are the top 10 DEGs between this population and the other myeloid cell types in the UMAP (from Table S2 in publication). In the publication we define a conserved mouse-human KC signature. These genes are listed as canonical marker genes for KCs.

labels.name: Mig cDCs
labels.rationale: Marker genes are top 10 DEGs for this population compared with others in UMAP (from Table S2 in publication).
